verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a revision workflow for feature flags. Users can draft revisions, request review, require approval, publish with a commit message, and revert to a prior revision from a Revision dropdown. That covers versioning, review and rollback, but only for feature configurations, whose rules can include ramps and schedules. It is not shown for automations as a distinct object, and approval workflows sit in a higher pricing tier. Missing for 10: versioning and rollback shown specifically for automations (ramp schedules, deploy-script or agent-driven changes), API/MCP access to revision history and revert, config-as-code versioning, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Draft feature revisions, request review, resolve merge conflicts, and require approval before publishing.
publish them all at once with an optional commit message.
use the Revision dropdown to select the version you want to revert to, then click Revert.
